title: 3D Cobwebs
description: This resource pack replaces the boring 2d illusion for the cobweb and adds a seperate 3d model which only changes the placed down version.
body:
🕸️ 3D Cobweb Pack
This resource pack replaces the standard flat textures with simple 3D models. It adds subtle depth to cobwebs in caves and dungeons for a more realistic look while staying true to the vanilla aesthetic. It is a clean, performance-friendly visual upgrade.
